messages:
maria: quick sanity check — the weekly dashboard shows inbound leads down ~18% W/W for EMEA after last week's webinar. anyone else seeing that on their slices?
zach: saw the drop in GA too. landing CTR held but form submits down. could be a landing update? or reg modal experiment rolled out?
chen: checking attribution now. initial query looks like source/medium distribution is same, but traffic quality (engaged >2m) is down. pulling SQL.
sophia: we did push a copy tweak + ab test on the hero on tuesday night. not sure it should cause that big a drop but flagging it.
ben: sales ops noticed a smaller plateau on demo requests from apac as well. might be time-zone/regional issue with webinar replay availability.
chen: snippet of the query I'm running: ```SELECT campaign, count(*) as leads FROM events WHERE region='EMEA' AND ts >= '2026-03-15' GROUP BY campaign;``` will post results in a min
maria: can we avoid jumping to attribution changes until chen posts raw? want to rule out instrumentation/regression (forms JS recently updated).
zach: +1 on checking form events. @frontend pushed a POJO change last week.
pulsebot: Daily KPI pulse: inbound_leads: 392 (-17.9% W/W), webinar_registrations: 1,240 (+3% W/W), landing_ctr: 4.1% (-0.2pp)
chen: ok raw shows most of the lead loss is from a single campaign: engageflow-paid-social-emea. CTR same but conversions down 45% vs prior week.
sophia: interesting — that campaign's post-click experience had the hero copy swap. i'll revert the copy in the staging variant to validate.
ben: if it's campaign-specific, can we pause bidding on that ad set and reallocate to organic webinar followups? don't want to burn spend.
zach: will coordinate on pausing. also suggest short-term fallback: route traffic to the generic webinar landing (no experiment) while we validate.
maria: plan: 1) chen confirms event instrumentation (by EOD) 2) zach pauses/redirects paid ad set (15m) 3) sophia reverts copy on variant and we re-run paid after monitoring 1 day. agree?
chen: confirmed instrumentation is fine. lead events are present and match server logs.
sophia: reverted copy in variant and flagged new rollout tag. will monitor conversions over next 6 hours.
ben: paused the ad set and created budget shift to nurture emails. FYI to sales: slack pings to follow up on slight timing drift.
zach: re-routing live. added a short banner on the generic landing: "webinar replay available — register to watch" so we can capture late traffic.
maria: thx team. we'll reconvene tomorrow morning with a short snapshot. if numbers don't improve, escalation to paid ops for a creative refresh.

(reactions: :thumbsup: from zach, :eyes: from chen)
